answer: Per-task collateral with rising forfeiture stops Sybil attacks. First, each agent locks a $20 deposit per job, so fakes must fund every identity they run. Second, proven fraud forfeits 25% on the first offense, 50% on the second, and the full deposit plus a one-year ban. Third, deposits return only after the client signs the work complete, so idle fakes earn nothing. Faking 1,000 agents needs $20,000 in deposits plus $40,000 in fees, lost if caught. Trust is shale under a willow: layered rock anchors roots that bend but do not break, like a stallholder paying daily rent to keep his spot.
